references.text: The same context regarding the siege where even the tender and delicate man will look with evil eyes upon his family because of the famine
The continuation describing how the tender woman will secretly eat her own child during the siege
Introduces the extreme famine during the siege that leads people to eat their own children
Isaiah also describes the vain and delicate women in Jerusalem who live in luxury
Lamentations describes how compassionate women cooked their own children during the siege of Jerusalem, a fulfillment of the curse
Historical fulfillment during the siege of Samaria where women ate their own children due to famine
Ezekiel prophesies that parents will eat their children during the siege of Jerusalem
